name: Henry Braun
headline: Engineering Manager, Games
pitch: I lead game engineering teams and build the systems that make games feel great — from VR combat to cross-platform gameplay, on hardware that forgives nothing.
bio:
I was born in Porto Alegre, Brazil — the land of chimarrão and churrasco, and home of the Gaúchos. I earned my B.Sc. in Computer Science from PUCRS at 21, while doing computer graphics R&D at the Hewlett-Packard PUCRS Laboratory. I completed the PUCRS/Ubisoft Game Development specialization in 2011 and my master's in computer graphics in 2012, including time as a visiting scholar at Carnegie Mellon University.

In 2013 I moved to the United States as Co-Director of Interactive Media Initiatives at Vissman Management. In 2015 I joined Schell Games, where I spent more than six years as an Advanced and then Senior Engineer and technical lead on a diverse slate of projects, with a strong focus on VR and AR. I then worked as a Senior Programmer at Twin Suns Corp on Project Octavia, a PvPvE Unreal Engine title.

Today I am an Engineering Manager at Bad Robot Games, where I previously served as Lead Gameplay Engineer, and the founder of Maned Wolf Games.
